verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents querying large codebases, and one hands-on user reports it navigated and learned very large codebases effortlessly. However, the docs are a single thin line, and another user reports it is slow and poor at codebase navigation. Missing for 10: documented features for explaining architecture or how components fit together, guidance on finding where to start making changes, in-depth first-party docs, and consistent independent corroboration of navigation quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can understand how a codebase fits together to find where to start making changes

citations.quote: I have thrown very large codebases at this and it has been able to navigate and learn them effortlessly.
